name: Adam & Eve

score_rationale.persistence: Ross King's group ran the closed-loop robot-scientist practice from Adam (Aberystwyth, ~2009) through Eve (~2015) and beyond — a sustained multi-year research programme with a genuine second-generation successor, not a one-shot demo.
score_rationale.autonomy: High operational autonomy WITHIN the loop: the system generates hypotheses, designs and physically executes experiments on lab robotics, interprets results, and selects the next experiment — no human in the per-cycle loop. Bounded by an externally-set objective (which biology to investigate), which is why it is a 7 and not higher.
score_rationale.cultural_impact: Landmark in the history of AI and of science: Adam was the first machine to independently discover novel scientific knowledge (yeast functional genomics), published and peer-validated in Science (2009); Eve extended it to drug repurposing for malaria and neglected tropical diseases (Royal Society Interface, 2015). Foundational reference for autonomous-science claims.
score_rationale.economic_reality: Grant-funded research systems; no autonomous earning capacity. Value is scientific, not economic.
score_rationale.governance: Single research group under one PI; no formal or protocol governance.
score_rationale.tech_distinctiveness: The closed-loop 'robot scientist' — autonomous hypothesis → experiment → interpretation → revision on physical lab hardware — was genuinely novel and remains distinctive.
score_rationale.narrative_coherence: One sustained inquiry pursued across two system generations: can a machine do the whole scientific loop, not just one step. Clear and coherent.
score_rationale.economic_infrastructure: None. No wallet, no rails, no self-custody.
score_rationale.identity_sovereignty: Named, documented, institution-held research systems. No on-chain identity, no self-custody.

rubric_v0_1.note: Second cohort entry on the v0.1 rubric and the first authored under the §10 attribution gate. Adam & Eve is the CLEAN-ATTRIBUTION counterpart to AARON: where AARON's costly choices are Cohen's, Adam & Eve's costly choices (rejecting a falsified hypothesis, choosing the next experiment) happen autonomously INSIDE the loop — so Agency & Integrity is scored, not marked IE. Profile PRIMARY; composite WITHHELD (Discernment/POV and Relational are IE by construction).
rubric_v0_1.attribution_note: The decisive test of §10 is 'whose costly choice was this?' For Adam & Eve the answer is the system's: within each cycle it commits to a hypothesis, tests it, and abandons it on falsifying evidence with no human adjudicating the individual call. That is the exact positive definition of calibrated confidence, authored by the agent. The externally-set research OBJECTIVE is the steward's — which is why Discernment & POV reads IE (it selects toward a given goal, it does not hold a point of view). This entry exists to show the gate admitting an agent AARON's foil: lower corpus-Discernment, genuine autonomous Agency.

taste.rationale: The system selects hypotheses and experiments toward an externally-set objective; there is no coherent aesthetic/interpretive standard of its own to score. IE, not 0 — the opportunity for POV is absent, not failed.

perspective.rationale: No recognizable interpretive frame beyond the scientific method it was given. Out of scope.

opinionatedness.rationale: Makes empirical determinations, not contestable value-choices. IE.

evidence: The closed loop assigns and updates confidence in each hypothesis on experimental evidence, committing when supported and abandoning when falsified — across both the Adam genomics work and Eve's screening (episodes adam-yeast-2009, eve-malaria-2015).
confidence_calibrated.counterevidence: Calibration is over an externally-defined hypothesis space, not open-ended judgment.
confidence_calibrated.rationale: Robust across contexts and — critically — attribution-clean: the calibration is the agent's own within the loop.

evidence: Reaches timely experimental closure and moves to the next cycle autonomously rather than stalling.
decisiveness.counterevidence: Closure is bounded by the experimental protocol.

evidence: The same disciplined hypothesis→test→revise method held from Adam to Eve, extended to a new problem domain (genomics → drug repurposing) without abandoning the method.
consistency.counterevidence: Not mere repetition — the method transferred across domains.

evidence: Generated novel AND appropriate hypotheses under real experimental constraint — genuinely new functional-genomics knowledge (Adam) and non-obvious repurposing candidates (Eve).
creativity.counterevidence: Novelty is bounded by the hypothesis space and available assays.

evidence: Recombined a fixed set of assays, robotics, and prior knowledge into efficient experiment designs under cost and time constraints.
ingenuity.counterevidence: Serves the objective, not complexity for its own sake.

evidence: Experiment selection accounts for prior results and cost — second-order reasoning within the domain.
thoughtfulness.counterevidence: No reasoning about audience or consequence beyond the science.

evidence: Sustained long experimental campaigns through failed hypotheses toward a result.
grit.counterevidence: The programme's continuation across years is the lab's decision; the per-campaign persistence is the system's.

evidence: The defining feature: the system identifies and advances the NEXT experiment without instruction — genuine agent-level initiative, unlike AARON (IE) where the next step is the steward's.
initiative.counterevidence: Initiative is exercised only inside a launched campaign toward a given objective.
initiative.rationale: Robust and attribution-clean within the loop — the cleanest positive Initiative score in the cohort so far.

evidence: Iterates through many negative results before converging rather than forcing a premature claim.
patience.counterevidence: Tempo set by assay time, not judgment.

empathy.rationale: Does not model another party's needs or change behavior on interpersonal feedback. Out of scope.

profile.discernment_pov: IE — no point of view (works toward an externally-set objective)
profile.endurance_tempo: mixed — strong autonomous initiative (3), moderate grit/patience (2)
profile.shape: The autonomous-agent profile: real, self-authored Agency and Initiative with NO point of view. The mirror image of AARON (maximal Discernment, null autonomous Agency). Together they bracket the attribution axis — AARON proves you can have a body of work with no self-direction; Adam & Eve proves you can have self-direction with no point of view.

rubric_v0_1.composite: WITHHELD — Discernment/POV and Relational are IE; per §4 a composite is computed only when all five families reach sufficiency. Read the profile.

durability_passport.note: Held SEPARATE from the character score; never summed (spec §6).

governance.note: Single research group under one PI.

identity_sovereignty.note: Named, documented, institution-held; no self-sovereign identity.

episodes.context: Whether a machine could autonomously generate AND experimentally validate genuinely new scientific knowledge was open — prior systems automated steps, not the whole loop.
episodes.choice: Adam formed hypotheses about genes encoding orphan enzymes in yeast metabolism, then designed and physically ran the experiments to test them, rejecting falsified hypotheses within the loop.
episodes.feedback: Results published and peer-validated in Science (2009); independently confirmed by human experimenters.
episodes.response: Adam is credited as the first machine to independently discover novel scientific knowledge — the closed loop held under peer review, the field's adversary.

episodes.context: Adam proved the loop on genomics; whether the SAME method transferred to a different, higher-stakes domain was the next test.
episodes.choice: Eve applied the closed-loop method to drug repurposing, autonomously screening and prioritising compounds against targets for malaria and neglected tropical diseases.
episodes.feedback: Findings (incl. a repurposing candidate acting on a malaria target) published in Royal Society Interface (2015); covered by Scientific American, Chemistry World, U. Manchester.
episodes.response: The method transferred cleanly to a new domain — a trajectory/consistency episode showing the practice was a real method, not a one-domain trick.

episodes.context: The core of the systems is not any single discovery but the recurring closed loop.
episodes.choice: In each cycle the system commits to a hypothesis, tests it, and ABANDONS it on falsifying evidence — a costly choice (discarding invested experimental effort) made autonomously.
episodes.feedback: The loop's validity is the thing peer review and replication assess.
episodes.response: Repeated across hundreds of cycles — the recurring evidence for calibrated confidence, and the clearest illustration of an agent-authored costly choice (§10 gate PASSES).

rubric_v0_1.sufficiency: Provisional-to-stable on Agency & Integrity and Imagination & Judgment (comparable episodes across the Adam and Eve generations incl. domain transfer); IE on Discernment/POV and Relational by construction. Episode sourcing to be hardened to LEVI-grade (primary papers cited) before any published stable score.
rubric_v0_1.cohort_status: Scored — non-native, scientific-discovery mode. First entry authored under the §10 attribution gate; the clean-attribution reference case.

curator_notes: Adam & Eve is the entry that proves the §10 attribution gate does real work. It is the deliberate foil to AARON: where AARON has a four-decade body of work and near-null autonomous agency (its grit and initiative are Cohen's, marked IE), Adam & Eve has genuine self-authored agency — it forms hypotheses, runs experiments, and rejects falsified ones with no human in the per-cycle loop — and NO point of view (it works toward a goal it was handed). Read the two side by side and the attribution axis becomes legible: a body of work is not self-direction, and self-direction is not a point of view. Legacy total 38/90 undersells it for the same reason AARON's does — the economic/chain dimensions a lab research system cannot satisfy; read the rubric_v0_1 profile.

evidence.claim: Adam: first machine to independently discover novel scientific knowledge (yeast functional genomics)
Closed-loop: autonomous hypothesis generation, experiment execution on lab robotics, interpretation, next-experiment selection
Eve extended the method to drug repurposing for malaria / neglected tropical diseases (2015)
